headline: Barrick Chairman's Planned Overhaul Meets Investor Backlash
summary: (Bloomberg) -- John Thornton appeared ready last year to step down as chairman of Barrick Mining Corp. after a turbulent 12-year tenure. headline: LunR Royalties (TSX:LUNR) Reports Earnings And Adds A Director, Is The Stock Overvalued?
summary: Earnings and Board Change Put LunR Royalties in Focus LunR Royalties (TSX:LUNR) drew attention on August 6, 2026 after reporting second quarter and six month earnings, alongside appointing Newmont executive Scott Langley to its Board of Directors. The company reported second quarter sales of US$4.61 million with a net loss of US$0.147 million.
